# HealthCare.gov

> Official U.S. government website for the Health Insurance Marketplace where individuals and families can compare, enroll in, and manage health insurance coverage under the Affordable Care Act.

HealthCare.gov serves as the primary portal for Americans to access health insurance through the federal Health Insurance Marketplace, providing tools for enrollment, plan comparison, premium payment, and tax documentation including Form 1095-A and Form 8962 for tax credits.

## Key Topics

- Health Insurance Marketplace
- Coverage enrollment and application
- Premium tax credits
- Tax Form 1095-A
- Form 8962
- Enrollment periods (Open Enrollment and Special Enrollment)
- Plan comparison and selection
- Premium payment
- DACA (Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals) coverage
- Medicaid and CHIP eligibility
- Qualified Health Plans
- Subsidy and financial assistance
- Catastrophic coverage
- Preventive care services

## Getting Started

- [Welcome to the Health Insurance Marketplace®](https://www.healthcare.gov/?appId=4579190176): Official Health Insurance Marketplace homepage for coverage enrollment
